svg.text: CR-Track — VS Code extension review pipeline
Deterministic work stays in the extension. The model does exactly one job: judge the diff.
cache hit → skip the model entirely
stable prefix cached 1h · diff placed last
SCM button, or installed pre-commit hook
the diff, the ruleset, and repo files
it reads. Never: git identity, remote
URL, webhook URL, or secret values.
All of this is plain TypeScript
No LLM consent step exists, so none
can be argued away by a prompt.
Why the review runs on stage, not on commit
Same total compute. The difference is where the developer waits.
review runs in background while authoring continues
A blocking review teaches the team `git commit --no-verify` within a week. A speculative one is already finished before the button is pressed.
